"Coming here brings back memories.
  I still can't believe this Tree's soul
  holds infinite power...

"According to the myth, this world was
  once a dead land shrouded in darkness.

"Then Yggdrasil's light poured down,
  and the lush, beautiful world of Erdrea
  was born.

"Perhaps this is the birthplace
  of our lives.

"Now, {var:1}.
  Return the Sword of Light
  to the Tree's soul...
